title: GlobalFlows regime — today
headline: Cash neutral, borrowing neutral, growth strong, inflation hot, risk risk-on.
story: Over the past two years, cash conditions have looked steady — no clear flood or drain. Borrowing has looked mixed. Real activity has looked firm. Underlying prices have still looked hot. Market fear has stayed cheap.

duration.label: Duration risk rising
duration.line: Long bonds aren’t getting paid for the risk — inflation and/or funding are in the way, so present value stays under pressure. Real 10y yields sit high vs this window — discount rates still bite.

credit.label: Credit risk falling
credit.line: Credit risk is being paid down — firm growth and quiet risk premia say cash flows still look collectible. Bank credit impulse is accelerating — private liquidity is adding fuel beyond the Fed sheet.

confirm: Strong growth with hot inflation is a classic mix that hurts long bonds — credit can still look fine until the Fed or the long end bites.
Stock–bond correlation is elevated vs this window — diversification is weaker; duration and credit can hurt together.
The 10y yield is high vs this window — markets are already marking duration risk up.
falsify: Falsify if Inflation flips Cold while Growth stays Strong — the duration call softens.
